revision_basis: The first complete exact-grid audit observed 760 off-grid timestamps. Add a separate one-second proximity diagnostic; keep the original exact audit and day selection.

window.day_interval: [00:00, next 00:00) on the date encoded by the workbook
window.grid_basis: Published data descriptor; inspect actual timestamps and report duplicates, irregular steps and off-grid values
window.clock_rule: Never modify or round the source timestamp. Report exact matches and, separately, whether a row lies within one second of a grid point.

rules.series: Use workbook-documented facility and Frontier power, flow and supply/return temperature; report absent or derived channels explicitly
rules.gaps: Count absent timestamps separately from present rows with invalid or missing values. Keep recorded zeros. No imputation or inference of outages from missing rows
rules.changes: Compute differences only over consecutive observed samples separated by exactly one nominal step. These are finite changes at release cadence, not physical response times
rules.heat_check: Compare the cached heat columns to both signed rho*c_p*Q*(T_return-T_supply) and the inspected workbook convention (rounded gallon conversion and zero on negative temperature difference). The plotted temperature difference stays signed. This is arithmetic, not an independent heat-meter comparison
rules.limits: No service delivery, crew time, authorization, second-scale parameters, causal inference or calibration claims. No facility or policy execution

heat_arithmetic.shared_supply_reference: Frontier2023 column I, as documented by the data publisher
